Trains to Blackpool

This is the train I would look at for the Blackpool Air Show. Northern runs direct trains to Blackpool North from Manchester Piccadilly, Liverpool Lime Street, Preston, Bolton and York, with about four trains an hour from Preston. Avanti West Coast runs one direct train a day from London Euston on weekdays and Sundays, but none on Saturdays, so change at Preston. From the station it’s about 15 minutes on foot to the Tower.
